# Technical schematics

Original course diagrams rendered with Mermaid CLI 11.17.0 on a white background. These are schematic explanations, not measured results or Imagen-generated illustrations.

The [source and review record](../../../how-did-i-generate-it/rsi/visuals/REVIEW.md) retains the first and revised galleries. Each published image maps to its gallery revision and index below. Source code: [lesson-diagrams.mjs](../../../how-did-i-generate-it/rsi/scripts/lesson-diagrams.mjs).
